function: Joint learned selection of active fluid-antenna ports and ISAC precoder maximizing downlink sum-rate under a sensing SINR constraint; MAE predicts unobserved port CSI (p. 2, 5, 9).
system: Downlink multiuser MIMO ISAC: BS with 2D fluid antenna (8x8 ports, 5 active), 5 sensing receive antennas, 3 single-antenna users, 3.4 GHz (p. 3, 10).
method: A2C reinforcement learning with pointer-network actor and LSTM critic selects ports; unsupervised primal-dual constraint-aware fully connected precoder network; supervised ViT masked autoencoder for CSI (p. 5-10).
data_channel: Own simulator: Jakes port correlation, complex Gaussian fading, path loss from [52]; random channel samples for RL, 120,000-sample dataset for the MAE (p. 3, 7, 11, 13).
test_conditions: Train and test in the same simulator; sweeps over array size, power, ports, CSI noise (10 dB SNR); MAE split 80,000/20,000/20,000; generalization not studied (p. 11-14).
baselines: Non-learned: MMSE precoder, random port selection, PGMax path-gain selection, exhaustive search; learned: only own NPN variants, no earlier learned method (p. 11-14).
metrics: Downlink sum rate (bps/Hz) under the sensing SINR constraint; NMSE of CSI extrapolation; inference time; training convergence (p. 11-13).
complexity: Big-O inference complexity of precoding and pointer networks (p. 8-9); inference time in milliseconds versus number of ports on an RTX 4090 GPU (p. 12-13).
q1_support: p. 3: "we adopt Jake’s model to characterize the spatial correlation"; own simulator with Gaussian fading and path loss of [52] (p. 11), no 3GPP, COST 2100, DeepMIMO or measured data.
q2_support: p. 14: "this paper did not consider the generalization of our learning-aided optimization algorithm"; the sweeps (array size, power, ports, CSI noise) state no train/test mismatch.
q3_support: p. 11: "“random selection”, “NPN without sensing”, “MMSE without sensing”, and “NPN”"; non-learned baselines exist, but NPN is the paper's own network (ablation) and no earlier learned method is compared.
q4_support: p. 9: "the overall computational complexity of the proposed algorithm is estimated"; p. 12: "Fig. 10 shows the inference time versus the number of ports".
q5_support: p. 13: "The dataset used for analysis consisted of 120, 000 samples"; self-generated simulation data, no link to code or data in the paper.
notes: Area 5: the learned precoder and port selection serve sensing and communication; the MAE channel extrapolation (area 2) is secondary, and the more specific area wins. Port selection of a fluid antenna could be read as antenna hardware design; kept because the networks also learn the ISAC precoder. q2: Fig. 13 (p. 14) varies the share of unobserved ports, but the paper never says the MAE is tested at a share it was not trained on, and Table I (p. 13) fixes 15 observed ports as input. Table I and figure legends read from page images (p. 11-14).
